description_expanded:
Grayton Beach!

Beachfront, next to Grayton Dunes Beach Access!

Panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico.

6 bedrooms, 6 baths, 2 half-baths

Stunning interiors!

Cool media room

5 bikes

Gas grill

Atypical by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Atypical is a great description of this magnificent gulf-front home, with stunning views of the beach and a portion of Western Lake, one of Walton County’s rare coastal dune lakes. Perfect for large families or groups, the remarkable house is a sleek, chic, feast for the eyes. It’s also warm and inviting, each room a charming display of modern aesthetics. The first level accommodates 13 guests with 5 bedrooms, including a primary suite, king, with a soaking tub and private patio. A guest room, queen, and a second guest room, queen, each have a private bath. A third guest room has a pair of twin bunk beds, while a fourth has bunks and a twin. Down the hall, cheer for your favorite team in the media room with stadium seating. Or have the kids watch their favorite movie.

Upstairs, a primary suite, king, has a soaking tub and an incredible walk-in shower. The second level also hosts the kitchen and living area, with panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico. The wonderful kitchen is a chef’s dream with high-end appliances including built-in, under-the-counter, Sub-Zero refrigerators and freezers. The two dishwashers can assist with cleanup. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - On the beach (Grayton Dunes Access) - 6 bedrooms, 6 baths, 2 half-baths - 3959 sq ft - On-site parking is limited to 2 vehicles - Additional public parking is available but not guaranteed - Wi-Fi - Gas grill - 5 bikes included Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary; bath; TV - Queen in 1st floor guest room; bath; TV - Queen in 1st floor guest room; bath; TV - 2 twin bunks in 1st floor guest room; bath; TV - Twin bunk and twin in 1st floor guest room; shared hall bath; TV - King in 2nd floor primary; bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
